extraction_metadata.extraction_notes: Single flowchart table, doc pages 8-13. Every page of the excerpt is landscape-rotated 90 degrees (page /Rotate is 0; the text is drawn rotated). Geometry was mapped to display space as dx=(792-y_pdf)*200/72, dy=x_pdf*200/72 and the raster was rotated 90 deg clockwise before rule-line detection. Column boundaries (27 vertical rules -> 1 label column + 25 data columns) and row bands were recovered from the 200 dpi raster (prompt section 1d) and are byte-identical on all six pages. Marks were binned from the pdftotext -bbox text layer into those rule-bounded cells (section 1b) and diffed against visual reads of the rendered pages. The header rows reprint on every page and were de-duplicated to four schedule_properties.

table_metadata.table_purpose: Single whole-trial schedule of activities for NN9536-4373: screening, randomisation, dose escalation, maintenance, end of treatment and end of trial, V1-V25 (weeks -1 to 75).
table_metadata.notes: Only SoA table in the excerpt; the section-2 heading 'Flowchart' is printed once, on doc page 8, and the same 26-column grid with the same four header rows continues to doc page 13, so this is one table, not a parent plus continuations. table_type=main_soa: rows are procedures performed on subjects and this is the protocol's primary anchor grid; there is no second column structure and no population split. One label column (L=1), so the first data column is position 2 and the 25 visit columns are positions 2-26. Source inconsistency: the Visit Window value for V2 prints as '±0' on doc pages 8, 9, 10, 12 and 13 but as '0' on doc page 11; the de-duplicated header carries '±0'. Source typo retained verbatim: 'Hand out and instruct in PK dairy' (row 79).

schedule_properties.property_comment: Top header band, label cell empty. Carries the study phases spanning the visit columns: 'Screening' (V1), 'Randomisation' (V2), 'Dose escalation period' (V3-V10, merged), 'Maintenance period' (P11-P23, merged), 'End of treatment' (V24), 'End of trial' (V25). Values are major study phases, so property_type=epoch; property_name synthesized because the row-label cell is blank and the row's type had to be read off the spanning geometry.
Visit identifiers V1-V25, prefixed V for site visits and P for phone contacts. Named visit labels, so property_type=visit. This row alone distinguishes every one of the 25 data columns.
Nominal timing of each visit expressed in whole weeks relative to randomisation (-1 at screening, 0 at randomisation, up to 75). Week numbers, so property_type=week.

Permitted deviation in days around each visit's nominal week ('-7 to 0' at V1, '±0' at V2, '±3' for V3-V24, '0 to +5' at V25). Visit windows, so property_type=window; kept in the header hierarchy below the week row as it qualifies each column's timing.

annotations.annotation_text: Demography consists of date of birth, sex, ethnicity, and race (according to local regulation).
Smoking is defined as smoking at least one cigarette or equivalent daily.
DEXA scan is performed in a sub-population.
DEXA scan should be performed in fasting state prior to randomisation (after informed consent is obtained).
Only for subjects where the separate informed consent for future research has been signed.
Fasting at V25 is defined as at least 2 hours without food and drink intake except water before attending the visit.
